environment.timingClaim: Isolated CPU JavaScript measurements; not browser or graphics-hardware performance

metadata.pooledRows: Rows aggregate levels for completeness; geometrySummaries carry the per-detail comparisons and confidence intervals.

protocol.sampler: Seeded uniform rejection sampling in free plan interiors; terrain XY margin 1 m + 8 m eye height; building XY margin 1 m outside footprints at z=10 m
protocol.sequence: Nested prefixes per geometry; round robin across geometry groups and individual tests

batching.calibration: Discarded adaptive doubling after one warmup
batching.samples: Three fresh timed batches normalized per solve; raw elapsed times and batch sizes retained

protocol.aggregation: Median of per-observer medians; spatial quartiles and 10–90% interval

confidence.coverage: All requested observer cases attempted; failures excluded
confidence.statistic: Median of per-position timing medians; percentile bootstrap interval, separate from spatial IQR

protocol.timing: Fresh synchronous CPU solves; SVG, error checks and counter instrumentation excluded; per-query footprints/grid preparation included
protocol.scope: Plan area, full terrain surface, observer viewport surface and building receivers are separate domains
protocol.extension: Terrain detail: paired physical XY across mesh levels; independent from baseline scene statistics
